errors.name: TimestampNotInFuture
errors.msg: The specified timestamp must be set in the future.

errors.name: DrawTimeNotReached
errors.msg: A winner can only be drawn after the scheduled draw time has passed.

errors.name: PendingWinnerDraw
errors.msg: You must draw a winner for the current cycle before setting a new drop time.

errors.name: MintCooldownActive
errors.msg: Maximum tokens have already been minted. Please try again after the free mint cooldown.

errors.name: CandidateDescriptionTooLong
errors.msg: The candidate's description exceeds the maximum length of 128 characters.

errors.name: VaultInsufficientFunds
errors.msg: The vault has insufficient funds to complete this transfer.

errors.name: InvalidTokenPrice
errors.msg: The specified token price must be greater than or equal to half of Vote receipt (21 bytes) account rent.

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdminAccess
errors.msg: Unauthorized: Only an administrator can invoke this instruction.

errors.name: InactiveCandidateVoted
errors.msg: Votes can only be cast for active candidates.

errors.name: FeeClaimCooldownActive
errors.msg: Registration fees can only be claimed after the free mint cooldown period.

errors.name: UserAlreadyUnregistered
errors.msg: This user has already unregistered.

errors.name: NotRegisteredForFreeTokens
errors.msg: The user is not registered for free tokens.

errors.name: CycleWinnerAlreadyDrawn
errors.msg: A winner for the current cycle has already been drawn. Set a new drop time first.

errors.name: MustUnregisterFirst
errors.msg: You must unregister before performing this action.

errors.name: OverallFreeMintLimitExceeded
errors.msg: The rate limit for free mints per epoch has been exceeded.

errors.name: InvalidCandidate
errors.msg: The provided candidate is an invalid candidate.

errors.name: IncompleteActiveCandidateList
errors.msg: You must provide all active candidates listed in the drop time account.

errors.name: EmptyCandidatePool
errors.msg: There are currently no valid candidates to choose a winner from.

errors.name: PendingReceiptsExist
errors.msg: You must close all receipt accounts first to prevent loss of funds.

errors.name: CannotCloseActiveCandidate
errors.msg: An active candidate cannot be closed.

errors.name: ClaimBackWindowNotOpen
errors.msg: The claim back window must be opened before claiming.

errors.name: RequiresReceiptClearance
errors.msg: Clear all receipts to immediately close this component.

errors.name: ZeroReceiptsImmediateClose
errors.msg: This component has zero receipts and can be closed immediately without a claim back window.

errors.name: IneligibleForTokenClaim
errors.msg: Tokens cannot be claimed for an active candidate or a winner candidate without claim-back offer.

errors.name: ReceiptCandidateMismatch
errors.msg: The provided receipt does not match the specified candidate.

errors.name: InactiveCandidateWithdrawal
errors.msg: Withdrawals are only permitted for active candidates.

errors.name: CannotCloseActiveReceipts
errors.msg: Receipt accounts cannot be closed while the candidate is still active.

errors.name: ZeroVotesProvided
errors.msg: The vote amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: OutsideClaimBackWindow
errors.msg: Tokens cannot be claimed at this time. The claim back window is either closed or has not yet opened.

errors.name: ClaimBackWindowStillOpen
errors.msg: You must wait until the current claim back window has closed.

errors.name: ActiveCandidateClaimBackWindowBlocked
errors.msg: An active candidate is not permitted to open a claim back window.

errors.name: InactiveCandidateClaimBlocked
errors.msg: Claim back offer cannot be set for a non-active candidate.

errors.name: InsufficientVotesForWinner
errors.msg: No candidate meets the minimum vote requirement.
